key_insight: SevenNet-Polar extends an equivariant GNN to predict Born effective charges alongside energy, forces, and stress, enabling fast charge-aware simulations with near-ab initio accuracy.
engineering_relevance: This makes electric-field and polarization modeling practical for large-scale materials workflows, including defect, interface, and perovskite solar-cell studies.
method: SevenNet-based equivariant graph neural network for multitask atomistic prediction
Separate BEC-only models and all-in-one models for energy, forces, stress, and BEC
Accelerated inference with FlashTP for large-system molecular dynamics on multi-GPU and consumer GPUs
evidence_signal: The abstract reports BEC RMSE as low as 0.0043 e and multitask accuracy of 1.0 meV/atom energy, 12 meV/angstrom forces, 0.05 GPa stress, and 0.0029 e BEC, validated on ZrO2, Li3PO4, and perovskites.
watch_item: BEC scaling is less favorable than energy/force/stress, so out-of-distribution structures or high-field regimes may still require careful validation.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
